aliases: グローバルサイエンスキャンパス
organizer: Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST / 国立研究開発法人科学技術振興機構), delivered through host universities in consortium with prefectural boards of education
organizer_domain_provenance: ESTABLISHED BY DOMAIN NAMESPACE. jst.go.jp is the domain of the Japan Science and Technology Agency, a Japanese national research and development agency (国立研究開発法人). The .go.jp second-level namespace is restricted by JPRS to Japanese government organs and incorporated administrative agencies, so the domain itself attests to the organiser's public status. IMPORTANT FOR ORYN INGESTION: .go.jp does NOT match looksOfficial()'s allowed patterns (.edu / .edu. / .ac. / .gov / .gov.), so this genuinely governmental Japanese source would be rejected by the current domain gate — see the lane README for the full list of affected records.
grade_range: 高校生等 — high school students and equivalent
prerequisites: Students must demonstrate outstanding motivation and ability within their region ('地域で卓越した意欲・能力を有する'). For the IT-focused strand, excellent results in a science olympiad such as the Informatics Olympiad (情報オリンピック) are required.
financial_aid: The official page notes that the IT strand receives private-sector financial cooperation ('民間団体の資金協力'). No participant fee or fee waiver is stated.
selection_process: Students are recruited and selected ('募集・選抜し') by each host university consortium on a regional basis. Selection criteria beyond demonstrated exceptional motivation and ability are not published centrally.
award_or_output: Advanced university-level lectures not available in ordinary high school, plus research conducted in university laboratories, within a systematic programme that includes international activities
source_title: グローバルサイエンスキャンパスとは – グローバルサイエンスキャンパス
research_notes: VERIFIED from the official JST page: JST as the operating agency, 高校生等 (high school students and equivalent) as the target group, the regional-excellence selection basis, the consortium model with prefectural boards of education, the olympiad prerequisite for the IT strand, and the programme content of advanced lectures plus university-laboratory research. NOT VERIFIED and deliberately left null — these are the fields a counsellor would most need: cost, application dates, duration, and the number of host universities. Secondary sources state the programme runs at roughly 15 universities with free tuition for participants, and that it began in 2014; NONE of that appears on the official page I fetched, so none of it is written into the record. The 'free tuition' claim in particular is a high-scrutiny cost claim and is therefore explicitly NOT recorded as fact. verification_state is NEEDS_REVIEW because recruitment is decentralised to each host university and I verified no individual university's live call, so I cannot assert that a current cycle is open. STRUCTURAL NOTE: like the Erasmus+ and JA records, this is a national framework rather than one bookable programme — the actionable unit is the individual host university's GSC call, of which there are roughly fifteen. Those would need separate records to be directly useful to a student.
